description: Per-eigenvalue, signed-character, operator-trace promotion of the scalar Φ_q brane-tower probe. For each isotope in {D, T, ³He} and each k in {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10}, computes tower_op^(k) = |Σ_λ y_λ(q_0) · tr_λ(Φ_q^{[≤k]}(ρ_λ(β)))| where ρ_λ(β) is the numerical braid operator in irrep V_λ (via Hoefsmit seminormal at q_0). Eigenvalues μ_a^(λ) via numpy.linalg.eigvals; Φ_q applied per eigenvalue; operator-trace = Σ_a Φ_q^{[≤k]}(μ_a^(λ)); Wedderburn-summed with signed y_λ (complex), final |·| at binding-formula level. Replaces the prior _avg_chi_over_classical_dim variant which used three approximations (classical dim, abs χ, mean-of-eigenvalues) that biased the result. Per-irrep eigenvalue spectra are persisted in data.per_atom[atom].rows[i].eigenvalues_{real,imag} for downstream audit and multiplicity-refined probes.
caveats: Absolute-form binding B = m_e·ρ·(|tr_M|+|tower_op|+σ_{3A}); subtractive form would require recomputing all per-irrep eigenvalues at include_inter=False, deferred.

Eigenvalues computed via numpy float64. For braid words where |μ| exceeds q_0^k_max, the per-eigenvalue Φ_q^{[≤k]} can overflow numerically — values are surfaced as errors rather than silently producing NaN. mpmath promotion is the obvious refinement if higher-k cases need to be probed quantitatively.
